title: Drainage Myth vs. Fact: Chemical Cleaners
description: Many property owners believe that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow-running drain is the fastest and safest fix for a blockage. In reality, corrosive chemical cleaners can sit in trapped sections of pipe, generate intense heat, and severely damage older metal and plastic piping materials. Professional plumbers know that mechanical clearing methods, such as augering or hydro-jetting, address the root cause of a clog without risking structural pipe failure or chemical burns. Understanding how to properly diagnose and clear a drain preserves the integrity of the entire drainage system.
caption:
Drainage Myth vs. Fact: Chemical Cleaners

Many property owners believe that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow-running drain is the fastest and safest fix for a blockage. In reality, corrosive chemical cleaners can sit in trapped sections of pipe, generate intense heat, and severely damage older metal and plastic piping materials. Professional plumbers know that mechanical clearing methods, such as augering or hydro-jetting, address the root cause of a clog without risking structural pipe failure or chemical burns. Understanding how to properly diagnose and clear a drain preserves the integrity of the entire drainage system.
